# GetArchivedChange

## Rules
- Ctor: `ArchiveRepository` (default-workspace scoped, kernel-injected).
- Input: `name` (required).
- Success: `Promise<ArchivedChange>` from archived `manifest.json`. MUST extend `ReadOnlyChangeView` + archive metadata (`archivedAt`, `archivedBy`, `archivedName`).
- MUST delegate to `ArchiveRepository.get(name)`; no own FS/index scan.
- `get` returns null → `ChangeNotFoundError` code `'CHANGE_NOT_FOUND'`, message includes name.
- No side effects (aside from possible `index.jsonl` recovery append inside `ArchiveRepository.get()`).
- Config factory via `resolveGetArchivedChangeDeps` (archive) only.

## Constraints
- Only error thrown by use case itself is `ChangeNotFoundError` — other errors from ArchiveRepository
- No workspace selection — single injected ArchiveRepository
- Returned `ArchivedChange` immutable
